kaushitaki_chapter5_verse2.title: Kaushitaki Chapter 5 Verse 2
kaushitaki_chapter5_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Kaushitaki, Chapter 5.
kaushitaki_chapter5_verse2.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Kaushitaki Upanishad, Chapter 5, Verse 2, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
kaushitaki_chapter5_verse2.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
